_readme: 局限性四层检查清单（可复用模板）。results_discussion 审计要求: 至少两条 limitation、覆盖 >=2 个 level、level 取以下四值之一、text 不得只写 'further work is needed' 类空话（rd.limitations_missing / rd.limitation_level_narrow / rd.limitation_vague）。按研究替换 text，保留 level 键名。

levels.method: 方法层——设计/流程/对照组的边界
levels.sample: 样本层——材料体系/受试者/样本量/代表性的边界
levels.measurement: 测量层——仪器精度/指标代理/单次测量的边界
levels.statistics: 统计层——检验效力/多重比较/模型假设的边界

examples.text: single material system tested; generality across chemistries is unverified
one coating thickness measured, so the thickness-dependence claimed here is a single point
the between-group test was underpowered for effect sizes below 20% (n = 10 per arm)
the coating was applied by one operator with one protocol; batch-to-batch variation is not covered

anti_patterns: more research is required to confirm these findings
limitations exist but do not affect the main conclusions
